name: The Mississippi Delta & Clarksdale
summary: The flat, cotton-rich Delta where the blues was born — the crossroads, a great blues museum, and juke joints still going strong.

lodging.name: The Shack Up Inn, Clarksdale
lodging.blurb: Sleep in a restored sharecropper shack on a cotton plantation.

foodMustTry.name: Delta hot tamales & fried catfish
foodMustTry.blurb: The Delta's own tamale tradition, plus catfish.

days.label: Day 269 — Birthplace of the Blues
days.summary: The crossroads and a juke joint.

item.title: Delta Blues Museum & the Crossroads
item.blurb: The blues told where it began, at the mythic crossroads of Highways 61 and 49; Dockery Farms nearby is often called the music's true cradle.

item.title: A Clarksdale juke joint
item.blurb: Live Delta blues in a genuine juke joint — Ground Zero or Red's.

commute.scenicNote: East across the Delta to Elvis's hometown.
